assertions.description: CSSImportRule.prototype exposes a styleSheet accessor (getter), per the CSSOM interface definition.
An @import whose supports() condition is false still appears in cssRules as a CSSImportRule (it is the fetch that is skipped, not the rule).
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@import url("/v158/cssimportrule-stylesheet/sheets/conformance-probe.css?conf-fs1=' + Date.now() + '") supports((display: pancake));'; document.head.append(s); try { const rules = s.sheet.cssRules; return rules.length === 1 && rules[0] instanceof CSSImportRule; } finally { s.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: For an @import with a false supports() condition, styleSheet returns null — there is no associated CSS style sheet because nothing was fetched.
assertions.test: (async () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@import url("/v158/cssimportrule-stylesheet/sheets/conformance-probe.css?conf-fs2=' + Date.now() + '") supports((display: pancake));'; document.head.append(s); try { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200)); const rules = s.sheet.cssRules; return rules.length === 1 && rules[0].styleSheet === null; } finally { s.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: An @import whose fetched resource is not a CSS style sheet (HTTP 200 but text/plain, rejected in standards mode) settles with styleSheet === null, not a phantom empty CSSStyleSheet.
assertions.test: (async () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@import url("/v158/cssimportrule-stylesheet/sheets/not-css.txt?conf=' + Date.now() + '");'; document.head.append(s); try { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const rules = s.sheet.cssRules; return rules.length === 1 && rules[0].styleSheet === null; } finally { s.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: An @import that loads exposes the imported CSSStyleSheet, and [SameObject] guarantees repeated reads return the identical object.
assertions.test: (async () => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@import url("/v158/cssimportrule-stylesheet/sheets/conformance-probe.css?conf=' + Date.now() + '");'; document.head.append(s); try { const t0 = performance.now(); let sheet = null; while (performance.now() - t0 < 2500) { sheet = s.sheet.cssRules[0].styleSheet; if (sheet !== null) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return sheet instanceof CSSStyleSheet && sheet.cssRules.length > 0 && s.sheet.cssRules[0].styleSheet === sheet; } finally { s.remove(); } })()

assertions.description: CSSImportRule.supportsText returns the import condition text for a conditional import.
assertions.test: (() => { const s = document.createElement('style'); s.textContent = '@import url("/v158/cssimportrule-stylesheet/sheets/conformance-probe.css?conf-st=' + Date.now() + '") supports(display: grid);'; document.head.append(s); try { const rules = s.sheet.cssRules; return rules.length === 1 && typeof rules[0].supportsText === 'string' && rules[0].supportsText.includes('display: grid'); } finally { s.remove(); } })()
